column1: # Your own certificate authorities: copy this file to known-roots.local.tsv (next to trust-audit;
# git-ignored, never shipped) and list the roots this machine is meant to trust that no public
# root program includes - internal PKI, TLS-inspection proxy, a CA pushed by GPO or MDM.
# trust-audit then no longer reports them as unknown, and says how many it accepted.
# One per line: the SHA-256 printed by trust-audit (upper or lower case), then, separated by TABs,
# optionally a label and why it is trusted (owner, ticket, date). Lines starting with # are ignored.
